state.standing_order: Survive and advance through the level. Defeat visible threats, collect useful resources, explore unvisited routes, open doors and reach the exit.

measurement_context.distance: Doom map units; player width32. Contact<64; close64-256; medium256-768; far>=768.
measurement_context.bearing: Relative degrees: 0ahead, positive LEFT, negative RIGHT. +90left -90right.
measurement_context.time: 35 game ticks per second. World continues during your calls. Aiming, movement and firing run simultaneously; controls persist until replaced or lease expires.
measurement_context.aim: Vertical aim automatic. TRIGGER fire grants permission during the control lease; the motor waits until the exact FACE enemy is currently visible and aligned before firing. FACE and TRIGGER are independent choices in this call. Hitscan stops at first solid obstruction.
measurement_context.physics: Max running speed about292 map units/second. Destination navigation follows collision-aware geometry. A gun must face its target to hit.
measurement_context.uncertainty: Entity health and keys unknown. remembered positions can be stale.

weapon_context.pistol: Hitscan, one bullet per shot. Accurate at modest range when aimed.
weapon_context.shotgun: Hitscan, seven pellets, about1shot/second. Strong under500units; pellet spread wastes shots at long range.
weapon_context.rocket launcher: Explosive projectile: dangerous to the player at contact range.

state.obstacle_context: Observed explosive barrels block movement and can explode if shot. Navigation routes around remembered barrel positions; destruction is unknown until observations change. Avoid firing through a barrel near the player.
state.strategy: Reach the exit alive. Fight visible threats while moving if useful. Use pistol or shotgun appropriately. Do not chase unneeded pickups. Explore distinct frontiers; avoid repeatedly failed destinations. Interact with doors and switches when close. Model chooses destinations; geometry supplies waypoints.

tactic.instructions: Choose one complete tactic. Priority: avoid OBSERVED immediate lethal exposure; when no such threat exists, make useful progress using reliable evidence. Do not choose inactivity merely because moving has hypothetical risk. Use the facts, standing order and prior outcomes. You cannot read the other rubric answers in this same call. These controls execute together; do not invent a new target or combination. Armor absorbs one third of every hit until it is used up and a shotgun ends close fights sooner than the pistol, so a 100-armor vest, a shotgun or a medikit near the route is useful progress for reaching the exit alive; a +1 bonus is a tiny pickup. Zombiemen, shotgun guys and chaingunners fire hitscan: the shot lands the instant it is fired at any distance in view, so retreating in the open or advancing past one in view does not reduce its hits; killing it, at close range with the shotgun when carried, or breaking line of sight does.
